costModel.metadataAccounting: A fresh metadata request that refreshes the project is the same counted refresh, not an additional full HR read. Do not add metadata and HR again for one refresh. Independently executed inventory calls are separate only when observed.
costModel.assumptions: Every modeled poll reaches the external reader, all users remain active for the modeled eight hours, no request coalescing suppresses those reads, one worksheet per binding.
costModel.variability: Coalescing/cache can lower realized usage; additional hooks, independent inventory, commands and retries can increase it. No claim that these projected monthly totals occurred.

target.conditionalMetadata: driveItem GET supports If-None-Match and 304; this is not a proven per-cell push or demonstrated worksheet-range conditional response.
target.manualFresh: Explicit authorized manual refresh requests an actual fresh observation; revision/read time and stale state remain visible.
target.writer: Retain existing writer ACK/idempotency/conflict/independent-read safeguards; writer inspections and pre-write checks must be accounted separately.
target.temporaryPath: Use the already valid Make access while removing redundant reads; a Graph authentication migration is not a prerequisite for all other closure work.
target.activation: Request-driven while an eligible authenticated session checks. No autonomous background scheduler or measured maximum latency without visible clients.
